# Best Google Ads Keywords for Roofing Companies (+ Negative Keywords to Block)

You’ve set your Google Ads budget. You’ve built your campaigns. Now comes the make-or-break decision: Which keywords should you actually bid on? Choose the…

![Best Google Ads Keywords for Roofing Companies (+ Negative Keywords to Block)](/_next/image/?url=%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2025%2F11%2Flooking-best-worst-google-keywords.png&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_QJtbabpHtErabYX7LZw2qERZi5zu)

You’ve set your Google Ads budget. You’ve built your campaigns. Now comes the make-or-break decision:

**Which keywords should you actually bid on?**

Choose the right keywords, and your ads show up when homeowners are ready to hire. You get quality leads, book jobs, and make money.

Choose the wrong keywords, and you’ll burn through your budget on clicks from people who will never hire you. DIYers looking for tutorials. People researching [roofing](https://pixelocity.com/roofing/) as a career. Competitors checking out your ads. Tire-kickers with zero intent to buy.

Here’s the hard truth: **most roofing companies waste 30-40% of their Google Ads budget on the wrong keywords.**

They bid on “roofing” (way too broad). They show up for “DIY roof repair” (wrong audience). They spend $35 per click on “roofing jobs” (people looking for employment, not hiring a roofer). And they wonder why Google Ads “doesn’t work.”

Keywords are the foundation of everything. Get them right, and the rest gets easier. Get them wrong, and you’re throwing money away.

In this guide, I’m giving you the complete keyword playbook for roofing companies:

*   The 100+ best keywords organized by intent and service type
*   Match types and when to use each
*   Local modifiers that multiply your keyword list
*   The critical negative keywords that stop wasted spend
*   How to research keywords specific to YOUR market

Let’s build your keyword list.

## Understanding Search Intent: Not All Keywords Are Equal

Before we dive into specific keywords, you need to understand that not all searches are created equal.

### The Three Types of Search Intent

**1\. High-Intent/Transactional Keywords**

These are people ready to hire RIGHT NOW.

**Examples:**

*   “emergency roof repair \[city\]”
*   “roof replacement estimate”
*   “roofer near me”
*   “24/7 roof repair”

**Characteristics:**

*   Highest cost per click ($25-$45)
*   Highest conversion rate (8-15%)
*   Shortest sales cycle (hours to days)
*   Best ROI

**When someone searches these, they’re not researching. They’re hiring.**

**2\. Mid-Intent/Consideration Keywords**

These are people actively looking but still comparing options.

**Examples:**

*   “best roofing [contractors](https://pixelocity.com/contractors/) \[city\]”
*   “roof replacement cost”
*   “roofing company reviews”
*   “\[roofing company name\]”

**Characteristics:**

*   Medium cost per click ($15-$30)
*   Medium conversion rate (5-10%)
*   Medium sales cycle (days to weeks)
*   Good ROI with proper follow-up

**They’re shopping around. You need to convince them you’re the best choice.**

**3\. Low-Intent/Informational Keywords**

These are people just starting to research or learn.

**Examples:**

*   “how long does a roof last”
*   “signs you need a new roof”
*   “how much does roof replacement cost”
*   “types of roofing materials”

**Characteristics:**

*   Low cost per click ($8-$18)
*   Low conversion rate (2-5%)
*   Long sales cycle (weeks to months)
*   Lower ROI but good for building awareness

**They’re not ready to hire today, but they might be your customer in 3 months.**

### Where Should You Focus?

**If you have a limited budget ($3,000/month or less):** Focus 80-90% on high-intent keywords. You need leads NOW, not brand awareness.

**If you have a moderate budget ($5,000-$8,000/month):** 70% high-intent, 20% mid-intent, 10% informational.

**If you have a large budget ($10,000+/month):** 60% high-intent, 30% mid-intent, 10% informational. You can afford to capture people earlier in the journey.

## The Complete Roofing Keyword List

Here’s your comprehensive keyword list, organized by category. I’m showing the root keyword—you’ll add your location to each (we’ll cover that in the Local Modifiers section).

### Category 1: Emergency/Urgent Keywords

These are your highest-converting keywords. Someone searching these needs help IMMEDIATELY.

**Primary Emergency Keywords:**

*   emergency roof repair
*   24/7 roofer
*   emergency roofer
*   roof leak emergency
*   emergency roof leak repair
*   same day roof repair
*   roof repair emergency
*   urgent roof repair
*   immediate roof repair

**Storm/Weather-Related:**

*   storm damage roof repair
*   hail damage roof repair
*   wind damage roofer
*   hurricane roof damage
*   roof repair after storm
*   emergency roof tarping
*   emergency tarp service
*   storm damage emergency

**Problem-Specific Emergency:**

*   roof leaking what to do
*   water leaking through ceiling
*   roof leak during rain
*   fix roof leak now
*   emergency ceiling leak
*   tree fell on roof

**Why these work:**

*   [CPC](https://pixelocity.com/cpc-made-simple-cost-per-click-for-small-business-owners/): $25-$45
*   Conversion rate: 10-15%
*   People call within hours
*   Close rate: 60-80% if you respond fast

### Category 2: Roof Replacement Keywords

These are your highest-revenue keywords. Lower conversion rate but much higher job value.

**General Replacement:**

*   roof replacement
*   roof replacement cost
*   new roof installation
*   replace roof
*   roof replacement estimate
*   residential roof replacement
*   complete roof replacement
*   full roof replacement

**Material-Specific Replacement:**

*   asphalt shingle roof replacement
*   metal roof installation
*   metal roofing contractors
*   tile roof replacement
*   slate roof replacement
*   flat roof replacement
*   TPO roofing installation
*   rubber roofing installation

**Property-Type Specific:**

*   residential roof replacement
*   commercial roofing contractors
*   home roof replacement
*   house roof replacement
*   garage roof replacement
*   shed roof replacement

**Why these work:**

*   CPC: $18-$35
*   Conversion rate: 6-10%
*   Average job: $10,000-$20,000
*   Long-term value: High referral potential

### Category 3: Roof Repair Keywords

Mid-range job value, good volume.

**General Repair:**

*   roof repair
*   roof repair services
*   residential roof repair
*   roof leak repair
*   fix roof leak
*   roof repair cost
*   roof patching

**Component-Specific Repair:**

*   shingle replacement
*   missing shingles repair
*   roof flashing repair
*   chimney flashing repair
*   roof vent repair
*   skylight repair
*   roof valley repair

**Problem-Based:**

*   leaking roof repair
*   damaged roof repair
*   cracked shingles repair
*   curlin

# 50 Best Roofing Keywords to Target for More Leads

August 14, 2024

Abby Kuhn

Keywords are the foundation of any successful marketing strategy, especially for service based businesses like roofing companies. They are the phrases potential customers use to search for the services you offer, making them crucial for connecting with your target audience. By effectively utilizing the right [roofing keywords](https://www.restorationmarketing.com/roofer-marketing), you can enhance your visibility, drive traffic to your website, and ultimately increase leads and sales. Incorporating keywords into various aspects of your marketing efforts ensures that your business appears prominently in search engine results, giving you a competitive edge in the market.

  

Targeting the right keywords is essential for roofing businesses looking to increase their online visibility and generate more leads. Below is a list of 50 high-impact roofing keywords, organized into categories to help you focus your SEO and PPC strategies effectively.

#### Location-Based Keywords

*   Roofing Contractor Near Me
*   Local Roofing Companies
*   Roofing Services in \[City Name\]
*   Best Roofers in \[City Name\]
*   Affordable Roofing in \[City Name\]
*   \[City Name\] Roof Repair
*   \[City Name\] Roofing Contractor
*   \[City Name\] Roof Replacement
*   Roofing Companies in \[City Name\]
*   Emergency Roofing in \[City Name\]

*   Flat Roof Repair

## How to Best Utilize Top Roofing Keywords

To effectively utilize these roofing keywords, start by incorporating them strategically into your website's content, including your homepage, service pages, and blog posts. Use these keywords in headings, meta descriptions, and throughout the body text to improve your site's SEO and ensure it ranks higher on search engine results pages. Additionally, optimize your [Google Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/10514137?hl=en) with location-based keywords to attract local customers. Running targeted pay-per-click (PPC) ads using these high-impact keywords can also drive immediate traffic to your site. Consistently updating your content with relevant keywords will help maintain your visibility and keep your roofing business competitive in the digital space.

  

### Roofing Keywords in Ads

Using targeted keywords in your paid advertising campaigns, such as [Google Ads](https://www.restorationmarketing.com/ppc), can significantly boost your visibility to potential customers who are actively searching for roofing services. By bidding on high-impact keywords, your ads are more likely to appear at the top of search results, driving immediate and relevant traffic to your website. This targeted approach ensures that your marketing budget is spent efficiently, attracting customers ready to take action.

  

### Roofing Keywords in SEO

Search engine optimization (SEO) relies heavily on keywords to [improve your website’s organic ranking](https://www.restorationmarketing.com/blog/7-simple-seo-fixes) on search engines like Google. By incorporating relevant keywords into your content, meta tags, and headers, you can enhance your website's relevance for search queries, making it more likely to appear on the first page of results. This organic visibility not only drives more traffic but also builds credibility and trust with your audience over time.

  

### Roofing Keywords in On-Page SEO

On-page SEO involves optimizing individual pages on your website with relevant keywords to improve their search engine rankings. This includes placing keywords in strategic locations such as titles, headings, URLs, and throughout the body content. Effective on-page keyword usage helps search engines understand the context and relevance of your pages, making it easier for them to match your content with user queries. Proper keyword placement can lead to better rankings, increased traffic, and more conversions.

  

### Roofing Keywords in Off-Page SEO

Off-page SEO involves activities outside your website that help improve its authority and ranking, such as link-building and social media marketing. Incorporating keywords into your off-page SEO strategy, such as in anchor text for backlinks or in social media posts, can enhance the relevance of these external signals. This boosts your website’s overall authority in the eyes of search engines, further improving its ranking for targeted keywords. Effective off-page keyword usage helps build a strong online presence, leading to sustained growth in traffic and leads.
